en.preface.html: Why study Claude Code's tool design? This preface explains the motivation, the 4-layer analysis skeleton, and how to read this book.
en.tool-mechanism.html: How Claude uses tools: the tool_use / tool_result round-trip, JSON Schema contracts, and the 4-layer design skeleton that shapes every Claude Code tool.
en.interaction/ask-user-question.html: Claude Code AskUserQuestion deep dive: structured card-based questioning that compresses decision time from minutes to seconds — replacing expensive natural-language round-trips.
en.interaction/enter-plan-mode.html: Claude Code EnterPlanMode explained: a zero-parameter tool that physically disables file editing, forcing Claude into read-only exploration before committing to an approach.
en.interaction/exit-plan-mode.html: Claude Code ExitPlanMode analysis: the approval gate that completes the Ask → Plan → Approve pipeline — why plan approval needs its own dedicated tool.
en.execution/grep-glob.html: Claude Code Grep and Glob tools: how ripgrep-powered search and glob-based file discovery give Claude precise coordinate-locating before reading or editing.
en.execution/read.html: Claude Code Read tool internals: line-numbered output, offset/limit pagination, multi-format support — the perception primitive that feeds Claude's understanding.
en.execution/edit.html: Claude Code Edit tool deep dive: exact string replacement, Read-first enforcement, uniqueness constraints — every rule prevents AI from making destructive file changes.
en.execution/write.html: Claude Code Write tool explained: full-file overwrite as the complement to Edit — when to use destructive replacement vs surgical editing.
en.power/bash.html: Claude Code Bash tool analysis: the most powerful and dangerous tool needs the longest prompt — capability catch-all, git safety protocol, dedicated-tool-first discipline.
en.power/agent.html: Claude Code Agent tool: how Claude spawns subagents to compress information and isolate context — the meta-tool that scales Claude Code from one AI to a team.
en.state/task-family.html: Claude Code Task family (TaskCreate/Update/List/Get/Stop/Output): externalized working memory that gives Claude persistent state across long-running sessions.
en.state/background.html: Claude Code Background mechanism: parameterization over toolification — how run_in_background turns synchronous tools async without adding new tools to the surface area.
en.state/cron-family.html: Claude Code Cron family (CronCreate/Delete/List): scheduling future work with anti-thundering-herd design and session-scoped lifecycle.
en.state/monitor.html: Claude Code Monitor tool: event-stream watching with stdout-as-notification — real-time log tailing, file watching, and CI polling without sleep loops.
en.info/web.html: Claude Code WebFetch and WebSearch: breaking beyond local boundaries with AI-processed web content — why Bash + curl isn't enough.
en.appendix-index.html: Claude Code tool index: lookup tables organized by problem-to-solve and by design philosophy — a quick reference for all 17 tools.
en.about.html: About Reading Claude Code Together — the open-source book dissecting Claude Code's tool primitives.
en.agent-loop/00-intro.html: How Claude Code turns one user prompt into an autonomous loop of LLM calls, tool execution, message updates, and stop conditions.
en.agent-loop/01-tool-permission.html: How tool schemas, permission rules, user approval, hooks, and classifiers determine whether a Claude Code tool call may execute.
en.agent-loop/02-hooks.html: How Claude Code hooks inject programmable logic at key points in the Agent Loop without destabilizing the main execution flow.
en.agent-loop/03-parallel-scheduling.html: How Claude Code batches tool calls, decides concurrency safety, schedules parallel execution, and converts tool failures into LLM feedback.
en.agent-loop/04-stop-reason.html: What each Claude API stop_reason means and how the Agent Loop decides whether to finish, continue, or enter recovery.
en.agent-loop/05-query-engine.html: A complete view of the Claude Code queryLoop state machine, where normal turns, retries, compaction, and recovery are peer transitions.
en.agent-loop/06-streaming.html: How Claude Code consumes SSE events, reconstructs messages, persists results, and renders incremental terminal output.
en.agent-loop/07-retry-recovery.html: Eight stacked recovery layers for network errors, rate limits, output limits, overloaded services, and exhausted context windows.
en.agent-loop/08-interrupt.html: How Ctrl-C propagates through the Claude Code Agent Loop and how synthetic tool_result blocks preserve message invariants after interruption.
en.agent-loop/09-sidechain.html: How the main agent and subagents reuse the same queryLoop implementation while agentId routes lifecycle behavior and output.
en.agent-loop/10-conclusion.html: The complete Claude Code Agent Loop: an automatic execution engine, explicit state machine, recovery system, and reusable subagent runtime.

zh.preface.html: 《一同读 Claude Code》前言：从 Tools、Agent Loop、Context 到 Memory，说明全书的四条研究主线与阅读方式。
zh.tool-mechanism.html: Claude 怎么用工具：tool_use / tool_result 往返、JSON Schema 契约、以及贯穿所有工具的 4 层设计骨架。
zh.interaction/ask-user-question.html: Claude Code AskUserQuestion 拆解：结构化卡片提问，把决策时间从几分钟压到几秒 —— 替代昂贵的自然语言往返。
zh.interaction/enter-plan-mode.html: Claude Code EnterPlanMode 拆解：一个零参数工具如何物理禁用文件编辑，逼 Claude 在动手前先做只读探索。
zh.interaction/exit-plan-mode.html: Claude Code ExitPlanMode 拆解：Ask → Plan → Approve 流水线的最后一环 —— 为什么方案审批需要独立工具。
zh.execution/grep-glob.html: Claude Code Grep + Glob 拆解：ripgrep 驱动的搜索 + glob 文件发现，给 Claude 精确的坐标定位能力。
zh.execution/read.html: Claude Code Read 拆解：行号输出、offset/limit 分页、多格式支持 —— 喂养 Claude 理解力的感知原语。
zh.execution/edit.html: Claude Code Edit 拆解：精确字符串替换、必须先 Read、唯一性约束 —— 每条规则都在防 AI 做破坏性文件改动。
zh.execution/write.html: Claude Code Write 拆解：全量覆盖作为 Edit 的互补 —— 什么时候该用破坏性替换 vs 精准编辑。
zh.power/bash.html: Claude Code Bash 拆解：最强也最危险的工具需要最长的 prompt —— 能力兜底、git 安全协议、专用工具优先纪律。
zh.power/agent.html: Claude Code Agent 拆解：Claude 怎么派生子代理压缩信息、隔离上下文 —— 把 Claude Code 从单 AI 扩展为团队的元工具。
zh.state/task-family.html: Claude Code Task 家族（TaskCreate/Update/List/Get/Stop/Output）拆解：外化工作记忆，给 Claude 持久状态。
zh.state/background.html: Claude Code Background 机制拆解：参数化而非工具化 —— run_in_background 如何把同步工具变异步，不增加接口面。
zh.state/cron-family.html: Claude Code Cron 家族（CronCreate/Delete/List）拆解：未来时间调度 + 防惊群设计 + 会话级生命周期。
zh.state/monitor.html: Claude Code Monitor 拆解：事件流监听 + stdout 即通知 —— 实时日志 tail、文件监控、CI 轮询，无需 sleep 循环。
zh.info/web.html: Claude Code WebFetch + WebSearch 拆解：AI 处理的网页内容突破本地边界 —— 为什么 Bash + curl 不够用。
zh.appendix-index.html: Claude Code 工具索引：按「解决什么问题」和「设计哲学」两张查找表 —— 17 个工具的速查参考。
zh.about.html: 关于《一同读 Claude Code》：系统拆解 Claude Code 的工具能力、执行流、信息流与跨会话记忆。
zh.agent-loop/00-intro.html: 从聊天窗口进入 Claude Code Agent Loop：LLM、工具调用和停止条件如何组成自主推进任务的循环。

zh.agent-loop/02-hooks.html: Claude Code Hooks 机制：在 Agent Loop 的关键节点插入可编程逻辑，同时保持主循环稳定。
zh.agent-loop/03-parallel-scheduling.html: Claude Code 工具调度：从 Read 到并行执行、并发安全分组，以及工具错误如何转换为 LLM 反馈。
zh.agent-loop/04-stop-reason.html: Claude Code stop_reason 深度拆解：模型为什么停止，以及主循环如何决定结束、继续或恢复。
zh.agent-loop/05-query-engine.html: Claude Code queryLoop 状态机全景：正常调用、重试、压缩和恢复如何成为并列的状态转换。
zh.agent-loop/06-streaming.html: Claude Code Streaming 机制：SSE 事件如何合并、存储并最终逐字显示在终端界面。
zh.agent-loop/07-retry-recovery.html: Claude Code 八层重试与错误恢复：网络、限流、输出上限和 context 超限如何逐层自救。
zh.agent-loop/08-interrupt.html: Claude Code Interrupt 机制：Ctrl-C 如何传播到 Agent Loop，并补齐未完成的 tool_result。
zh.agent-loop/09-sidechain.html: Claude Code Sidechain 与 Sub-agent：主代理和子代理如何复用同一套 queryLoop，并通过 agentId 分流。

zh.context-management/02-message-invariants: Claude Code messages 数组的三条不变量：只追加、role 交替，以及 tool_use 与 tool_result 必须配对。
zh.context-management/03-prompt-cache.html: Prompt Cache 如何成为 Claude Code 的架构骨架：稳定前缀、缓存断点与动态信息的布局原则。
zh.context-management/04-compaction.html: Claude Code Compaction 全景：手动、自动、微压缩、应急压缩与跨会话压缩如何协作。

zh.context-management/06-sub-agent.html: Claude Code Sub-agent context 隔离：独立消息历史、fork、worktree 与结果回传的边界。

zh.context-management/08-conclusion.html: Context 系列收尾：从 200K 预算、消息不变量到 cache-first 信息组织系统。

zh.memory/02-auto-memory.html: Claude Code Auto Memory：一次纠正如何沉淀到 MEMORY.md，并在后续 session 中重新生效。

zh.memory/04-subagent-memory.html: Claude Code Subagent Memory：Agent 类型如何在 user、project、local 三层目录中持久化记忆。
zh.memory/05-extraction-pipeline.html: Claude Code Memory Extraction Pipeline：一轮结束后如何通过受限 fork 提取并保存长期记忆。
zh.memory/06-team-memory-sync.html: Claude Code Team Memory Sync：私人记忆与团队记忆如何分目录保存，并与服务端同步。
zh.memory/07-managed-claude-md.html: Managed CLAUDE.md 企业管控层：组织规则如何统一下发，以及行为指引与硬性拦截的边界。
zh.memory/08-post-compaction.html: Claude Code Compaction 之后的记忆生命周期：哪些内容会自动回来，哪些需要重新触发。
zh.memory/09-conclusion.html: Memory 系列收尾：根据作用域、产生者和时间尺度，在五种记忆载体之间做选择。
